intent: Technical Brief: HP Victus 15 System State Baseline
suggested_solution: Keep the laptop plugged in while using it.
Shut down the laptop after use.
Get as much air intake for the laptop to prevent overheating.
Do not keep the laptop on your legs directly.
Close background apps that are not necessary.
Do not use the laptop directly under sunlight or warmer conditions.
Enable Battery Saver and set the battery mode to always-on.
